id: title:Gilbert09:add dataforseo backlink keyword and serp tables

review.posthog_relevance: Adds ingestion support and configuration for DataForSEO warehouse connectors, including keyword-scoped search volume and SERP data, with metadata and primary key definitions.
review.reason: This chunk demonstrates the implementation of keyword-scoped ingestion and warehouse configuration. P1.F3.H5 and P1.F3.H6 show keyword parsing, deduplication, and payload construction. P1.F3.H7 establishes global scope. P1.F4.H3 and P1.F4.H4 define metadata and global lookup tables. P1.F5.H1 imports keyword scopes. P1.F6 and P1.F8 are excluded as they contain only tests and config,
review.uncertainty: The chunk lacks complete implementation of warehouse ingestion and pagination, and P1.F6 and P1.F8 are excluded as they contain only tests and config, and P1.F8 is excluded as it contains only metadata and configuration. The tier is assigned based on the implementation of keyword parsing and metadata, but the complete ingestion and pagination are not shown.
